name: ghcp-maestro-vscode
description: Multi-agent workflow runtime for VS Code — /maestro chat participant with a TUI-like run console and per-agent drill-down. Shares the ghcp-maestro runtime core.

chatParticipants.name: maestro
chatParticipants.description: Decompose a task, fan out isolated agents in parallel, watch them in the Maestro views.

commands.name: task
commands.description: Decompose a natural-language task and fan out subtasks

commands.name: brainstorm
commands.description: Brainstorm a topic from multiple lenses in parallel

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a saved workflow by name

maestro.copilotPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Copilot CLI binary used to spawn isolated agent sessions. Required on the VS Code surface because `process.execPath` is the VS Code Electron runtime, not Copilot. Leave empty to use the `COPILOT_CLI_PATH` environment variable.
